name: suicide_burn_g12
notes: Suicide burn with 3× AeroTech G12 (Δv≈I/m≈175 m/s, total impulse ≈438 N·s). Drop from rest 10 m east at 110 m AGL — just below the practical closed-loop soft limit (~110–112 m with 10 m east divert; upright ideal ~129 m). Motors light after 2.9 s freefall. force_max exceeds the G12 spike so the mixer keeps axial thrust near full while killing freefall; after soft capture force falls toward hover and the altitude loop settles into the pad box (~0.8 m). Altitude gains (kp=5.5, kd=19, force_min=5) trade a bit of freefall D-gain for post-capture descent authority — high kd alone hung the vehicle ~2.5 m AGL until burnout. max_tilt 8°. Success = pad box at burnout, no hard contact during burn.
